caption: The master key lives outside the database in a wallet/keystore.

code:
-- Tablespace level (recommended default)
CREATE TABLESPACE encrypted_data
  DATAFILE 'enc_data01.dbf' SIZE 500M
  ENCRYPTION USING 'AES256'
  DEFAULT STORAGE (ENCRYPT);

-- Column level (narrower, older)
ALTER TABLE hr.employees
  MODIFY (ssn ENCRYPT USING 'AES256' NO SALT);
caption: Tablespace encryption covers every object automatically; column encryption is per-column.
